entries.en: Added MCP tool result persistence override via `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` annotation (up to 500K), allowing larger results like DB schemas to pass through without truncation
entries.zh: 通过 `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` 注释添加了 MCP 工具结果持久性覆盖（最多 500K），允许更大的结果（例如数据库模式）通过而无需截断

entries.en: Added `disableSkillShellExecution` setting to disable inline shell execution in skills, custom slash commands, and plugin commands
entries.zh: 添加了`disableSkillShellExecution`设置以禁用技能、自定义斜线命令和插件命令中的内联 shell 执行

entries.en: Added support for multi-line prompts in `claude-cli://open?q=` deep links (encoded newlines `%0A` no longer rejected)
entries.zh: 在 `claude-cli://open?q=` 深层链接中添加了对多行提示的支持（编码换行符 `%0A` 不再被拒绝）

entries.en: Plugins can now ship executables under `bin/` and invoke them as bare commands from the Bash tool
entries.zh: 插件现在可以在 `bin/` 下附带可执行文件，并在 Bash 工具中直接用命令名调用

entries.en: `/feedback` now explains why it's unavailable instead of disappearing from the slash menu
entries.zh: `/feedback` 不可用时，现在会说明原因，而不是从斜杠菜单中消失

entries.en: Improved `/claude-api` skill guidance for agent design patterns including tool surface decisions, context management, and caching strategy
entries.zh: 改进 `/claude-api` 技能指导：增加代理设计模式的内容，包括工具范围决策、上下文管理和缓存策略

entries.en: Improved performance: faster `stripAnsi` on Bun by routing through `Bun.stripANSI`
entries.zh: 改进性能：在 Bun 上通过 `Bun.stripANSI` 处理，`stripAnsi` 更快

entries.en: Edit tool now uses shorter `old_string` anchors, reducing output tokens
entries.zh: 编辑工具现在使用较短的`old_string`锚点，减少输出标记

entries.en: Fixed transcript chain breaks on `--resume` that could lose conversation history when async transcript writes fail silently
entries.zh: 修复 `--resume` 时转录链断裂，异步转录写入静默失败可能导致对话历史丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `cmd+delete` not deleting to start of line on iTerm2, kitty, WezTerm, Ghostty, and Windows Terminal
entries.zh: 修复了`cmd+delete`在 iTerm2、kitty、WezTerm、Ghostty 和 Windows 终端上不删除到行首的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan mode in remote sessions losing track of the plan file after a container restart, which caused permission prompts on plan edits and an empty plan-approval modal
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话中的计划模式在容器重新启动后丢失计划文件的情况，这导致计划编辑时出现权限提示和空的计划批准模式

entries.en: Fixed JSON schema validation for `permissions.defaultMode: "auto"` in settings.json
entries.zh: 修复了 settings.json 中 `permissions.defaultMode: "auto"` 的 JSON 模式验证

entries.en: Fixed Windows version cleanup not protecting the active version's rollback copy
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 版本清理不保护活动版本的回滚副本的问题
